units.source_text: 源氏公子看了这回书，觉得在他所交往的诸女子中，此人的笔迹最为优秀。

en.t: Prince Genji read this reply and felt that, among all the women he had known, this person's handwriting was the finest.

units.source_text: 他想：“人世之事，真不可解！

en.t: He thought, "The affairs of this world are truly beyond understanding!

units.source_text: 我所钟爱的诸人，性情容貌，各尽其美。

en.t: All the people I love have their own perfection in temperament and appearance.

units.source_text: 但恨不能集中爱情于一人，如何是好？”

en.t: Yet I regret that I cannot fix all my love on one person; what am I to do?"
His heart was gloomy and joyless.

units.source_text: 其时日色已昏，连忙再写一信奉报：“来书所云‘其浅仅濡袖’，不知何故如此其浅？

en.t: By then the daylight had already faded, and he hurriedly wrote another reply: "In your letter you say, 'It is so shallow it merely wets the sleeves'; I wonder why it should be so shallow?

units.source_text: 都缘卿心不深，反而托辞恨我吧！

en.t: It must all be because your own heart is not deep, yet you turn around and use that as a pretext to resent me!
